title.value: Early Detection of Sexual Predators with Federated Learning
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the provided document details and succinctly describes the core focus of the paper.
title.quote: Early Detection of Sexual Predators with Federated Learning

extractions.description: This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework aimed at the early detection of sexual predators in online conversations. The framework operates across different devices and leverages differential privacy to enhance user data protection while training language models to identify grooming activities in chats. Empirical results demonstrate its effectiveness using the PANC dataset. The paper also considers the ethical implications and limitations of such approaches in real-world applications.
